description: Synthetic data. Strings containing PRIVATE are bait and must never appear in any output field. Settings omitted from a case use the spec defaults with sharing, Show T3 activity and app icons on. Expected keys absent from a case are not checked; null means the field must be absent. Asset values are keys before URL resolution. largeText/smallText compare the hover text. A case passes 'now' = workSessionStart + 600 and all snapshots are fresh unless marked partial.
